- [2341] test ( 'update user settings' , { lock : 'user-settings' } , async ( { page } ) => { // never runs at the same time as other tests holding 'user-settings' } ) ;
- // never runs at the same time as other tests holding 'user-settings'
- A test can hold multiple locks, and accepts a for the whole group. Learn more about .
- and called without a selector search in any frame of the subtree, so you no longer need to locate the iframe first:
- [2380] // Finds the button in any frame on the page. await page . frameLocator ( ) . getByRole ( 'button' ) . click ( ) ;
- // Finds the button in any frame on the page.
- The rest of the locator resolves inside a single frame, just like a regular locator, and an error is thrown when it matches elements in several frames.
